title: Leakage-aware classification of indoor air quality from low-cost sensors: code, configuration and results
description: Code, configuration file (config.yaml), data and results for a leakage-aware benchmark of twelve classifiers that infer indoor air quality status (CO2-based and multi-pollutant: CO2, PM2.5, TVOC) from low-cost temperature, humidity, light and sound sensors, under random, leave-one-day-out, leave-sites-out and chronological validation. Datasets: Occupancy Detection (Candanedo & Feldheim, 2016), work-from-home IEQ (Manu & Rysanek, 2024), Lovric et al. (2025); DALTON (Karmakar et al., 2024) is rebuilt by scripts. Source: https://github.com/hamirulhamizan/iaq-lowcost-sensing-benchmark
